config.purpose: T13 bound the MLX free allocator cache before another full training attempt

hypothesis: Default MLX free-cache limit equals its much larger memory limit. Repeated allocations may retain unused Metal buffers across shapes; bound that cache without changing active tensors or loss.

probe.purpose: Longer allocation-growth probe on the same longest training examples; not a policy-quality run.

continuation: Only after successful probe, restart the full 800-microbatch run from the unchanged initial adapter. Discard probe updates; retain full 480-example validation and shared heavy-ML mutex.
